title: Unbounded K-flat replacements from functorial flat resolutions
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with a monoidal structure $(\otimes,\mathbf 1)$ whose tensor product is additive in each variable. Colimits are as in [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]; countable coproducts mean colimits over countable discrete categories, and $\mathbf Z$-indexed colimits mean colimits over the ordered set $(\mathbf Z,\leq)$. Assume countable coproducts exist, $\mathbf Z$-indexed colimits exist and their colimit functor preserves short exact sequences, and tensoring on either side with any fixed object preserves both those coproducts and those colimits. A flat object means an object whose tensor functors on both sides preserve short exact sequences. Assume there is a functor $P:\mathcal C\to\mathcal C$ with flat values and a natural epimorphism $P\Rightarrow\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C}$. For every unbounded cochain complex $K$ in $\mathcal C$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], there are a K-flat complex $Q$ [def-sfb-preserves-kflat-quasi-iso] and a quasi-isomorphism $q:Q\to K$.
